alt: A national insurance office: a blue-grey limestone civic building with a flat roof, a colonnade of square stone piers, wide steps, tall amber-lit windows, a bronze double door and a carved stone umbrella relief above the entrance, with trimmed hedges and topiary, on a paved square base plate

provenance.prompt: Isometric game building icon for a historical civilization strategy game: a national insurance office, a dignified mid-century civic building of soft blue-grey limestone with a flat roof and a low parapet, a covered colonnade of square stone piers along the front, a wide flight of stone steps, tall rectangular windows glowing warm amber in even rows, a heavy bronze double door, a large carved stone relief of an open umbrella above the entrance with no lettering, and trimmed hedges along the base. One building on a small square base plate, three-quarter view from above and slightly right, centred and filling about 80% of a square image. Clean hand-painted 2D game art, bold dark ink outline, flat cel shading with soft highlights, earthy saturated palette, readable at 40 pixels. Plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background, no ground scenery beyond the base plate, no shadows on the background. No flag, no banner, no queue, no people, no animals, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signs, no readable screens, no smoke, no watermark. Square 1:1 image.
